scenes.say: Picture this. One tree shades just one of your solar panels.
And your whole system's output drops.

lines: In a simple string, one shaded
scenes.say: In a simple string, shade on one panel can reduce the output of the whole string.
Optimizers or microinverters usually recover a big share of those shade losses.
But heavy, all-day shade can't be fixed with electronics. Trimming trees or using another roof face matters more.
Got a shady roof? Read the free guide at viva voltia dot com.
